name: SAM D21 Curiosity Nano (DM320119)
description: Small breadboard-friendly SAMD21G17D board with a built-in nEDBG-class debugger, virtual COM port and drag-and-drop programming, plus adjustable 1.7-3.6 V target voltage.
notes: One yellow user LED and one mechanical switch; the debugger also provides a Data Gateway Interface logic analyzer. Powered from USB through a MIC5353 LDO (500 mA).
Headers are not populated by default. Microchip's own page returns 403 to automated fetches so price comes from DigiKey ($10.61); board size and GPIO count are estimates.
